description: When: you hold an API contract and want it checked. Gives: spec → is this OpenAPI 3.x document valid (required fields, unique operationIds, undeclared $ref, missing 2xx; errors with JSON pointers); schema + value or values → does each JSON value satisfy this JSON Schema (draft-07 subset; a keyword it cannot evaluate reads INCONCLUSIVE, never valid). One gate per check, the worst on top. Deterministic, no network. Does not prove: that the running API returns what the spec says (pass a real response as value against its schema), nor anything about keywords outside the subset.

spec.description: OpenAPI 3.x document, JSON or YAML text, or the parsed object.

value.description: One JSON value to check against schema (a scalar as JSON text, e.g. "0").

values.description: Several values, e.g. responses captured from the API; each checked.

name: check_api_contract
